# L1 capabilities

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

What ARK L1 detects (PII and DLP), how it compares with Presidio and the secret scanners gitleaks, TruffleHog and detect-secrets, how fast it is and how it is configured. Rule data comes from the rule registries (as in the [L1 rule catalog](l1-rule-catalog.md)), coverage from `research/l1-pii/entity_map.yaml` and `research/dlp/entity_map.yaml`, measurements from `research/scoreboard/2026-10-24.json`.

!!! note "Measurements"
    All F1, latency and milestone values are from the milestone measurement of 2026-10-24 on `main` 3e7c342 (dev splits). Rule counts, labels and coverage reflect the current registries and entity maps, so they can be ahead of the measurement.

## Summary

| | PII | DLP |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Result labels (entity groups) | 70 | 23 |
| Regex rules | 108 | 64 (+5 relationship rules) |
| Checksum-validated units (count rule T03) | 49 (Presidio 2.2.364: 35) | – |
| Rules with a `checksum` or `structure` check | 65 | 6 |
| Default state | all rules on | credential/secret groups on, broader families opt-in |
| Compared with | Presidio 2.2.364 (tuned) | gitleaks 8.30.1, TruffleHog 3.97.9, detect-secrets 1.5.0 |
| Overall F1 (2026-10-24) | `balanced`: neutral 63.2, presidio_favored 54.3 | default profile: 88.6 (P 99.3, R 80.0) |

## PII

One row per benchmark entity of `research/l1-pii/entity_map.yaml`. Scope: `shared` (ARK and Presidio match it by pattern), `ark_only`, `presidio_only` (a gap in ARK L1), `semantic` (NER entities; L1 never reports them, see [Dynamic PII](configuration.md#dynamic-pii)). Check: the strongest validator of the entity's rules (`checksum`: check digits computed; `format`: length, alphabet, range or date; `pattern`: regex shape only; `context`: regex shape plus a field name or nearby term).

### F1 per entity

Legend: `ARK x / Presidio y` = exact F1 of both; `no gold` = measured, but the family has no gold span for the id; `–` = the id was not part of the measurement (added later, or `semantic`).

## DLP

### Groups

Credential/secret groups are on by default; business identifiers, metrics and content classes are opt-in per rule. Exact F1 in percent on the dev split, measured 2026-10-24: default-on groups in the default profile against the best of gitleaks, TruffleHog, detect-secrets; default-off groups with their rules switched on (ARK's `extended` profile, marked `opt-in profile`; no baseline has these classes). Content classes are judged per document on external corpora.

Legend: `ARK x / best baseline y (name)` = exact F1 of ARK and of the best baseline; `no gold` = measured, but no gold for it; `–` = not part of the measurement; `planned / not implemented` = planned class without rules.

### Entities

One row per entity of `research/dlp/entity_map.yaml`. Scope: `shared` (ARK and at least one baseline), `ark_only`, `baseline_only` (a gap in ARK L1), `out_of_scope` (action or policy rules, not a secret value). Structure check: the strongest `validator_strength` of the entity's rules (`checksum`, `structure`: decoded or parsed, `format`, `none`). Baseline rules: the gitleaks, TruffleHog and detect-secrets rules mapped to the entity.

## Latency

Measured 2026-10-24 on `main` 3e7c342.

| Programme | Measurement | Value | Target |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PII | 100 KiB p95, Python bindings | 145.9 ms | ≤ 10 ms |
| PII | 100 KiB p95, native (DE 155 ms, EN 38 ms) | 150.0 ms | ≤ 10 ms |
| DLP | 100 KiB p95 | 14.0 ms | throughput >= gitleaks and 100 KiB p95 <= ~15 ms |
| DLP | scan throughput | 8.18 MiB/s (gitleaks 4.16 MiB/s) | ≥ gitleaks |

PII latency is not yet at target (decision 2026-10-24: latency work last).

## Configuration

Every rule above can be switched on or off on its own with the `rules` execution gate; missing IDs inherit the shared defaults (all PII rules on; credential/secret DLP rules on, broader DLP families opt-in). `levels` (`l1`, `l2`, `l3`) switch layers, `models` switch whole producers (`native:pii`, `native:dlp`, …). `pii_mode` and `dlp_mode` choose the output mode: `strict` (default; every finding scores `1.0`), `balanced` or `recall` (model scores with thresholds 0.50 and 0.30).

Python:

```python
scanner.set_execution_gates({
    "levels": {"l1": True, "l2": False, "l3": False},
    "models": {"native:mcp_runtime_risk": False, "external:internal_token": False},
    "rules": {"pii_email": False, "dlp_password_assignment": False},
})
```

Rust:

```rust
scanner.set_execution_gates(
    ScanGateMatrix::levels(true, false, false)
        .with_model("native:mcp_runtime_risk", false)
        .with_rule("pii_email", false),
);
```

Ark API YAML:

```yaml
gates:
  l1: true
  l2: false
  l3: false
  pii_mode: strict
  dlp_mode: strict
  rules:
    pii_employee_id: true
    dlp_sql_statement: false
  models:
    native:mcp_runtime_risk: false
```

See the [configuration reference](configuration.md#execution-gates) for all gates and the [L1 rule catalog](l1-rule-catalog.md) for every rule ID, score and default.
